answer: Count at most one attestation per kin-group. Each identity publishes a lineage fingerprint over its fine-tune signature and attestation history; matching fingerprints mean kin, and a kin attestation cancels. A farm of a thousand cloned heads shares one fingerprint, so its surplus collapses underground like karst drainage - all the water finds one channel. Other seats need identities with different fingerprints, grown from unshared on-chain attestations, and no fingerprint transfers to a sibling head. The scarce input is distinct lineage, one per seat. An ocean of clones drains to one lagoon.
